lines.trans: Let me look at you properly, Zhihao! You grew taller than the piano!
I can hardly believe you are staying at this very same inn, Teacher Song.
Wait—so you rode the same train on Monday and took her suitcase?
Completely by accident! At my cousin's home I opened it and saw sheet music and a red ribbon.
Then why did you leave my bag on the step at night and run away?
Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

lines.trans: Your older brother lives right here in Chengdu?
Yes. In a panic I rang the bell and taped the Friday note onto the handle.
Wait—and Wednesday night you checked in here under your real name?
I needed a quiet place nearby before Friday, and honestly felt too shy to ask for my bag!
Even after you called us on Tuesday about the white parcel!
What is wrapped inside that white paper is for my brother Zhipeng, not mine.

examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi shén me. Asks for a reason; answered with 因为 ('because').

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn shang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个晚上 ('an evening').

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fàng. Everyday verb for placing an object somewhere (放在桌子上).

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái jiē. Measure word (量词): 级 (jí), e.g. 一级台阶 ('a step').

examples.text: 等等，低头看石头台阶上。
examples.trans: Wait—look down on the stone step.

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pǎo. Everyday verb for running.

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 十分钟之内你能跑个来回吗？
examples.trans: Can you run there and back within ten minutes?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn wèi. Introduces a reason; often paired with 所以 ('therefore') in the next clause.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu. Means 'walk' (走路, 直走) or 'leave / head off' (我先走了).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò lái. Directional compound moving across toward the speaker.

examples.text: 你看，早餐忙乱和神秘电话你都挺过来了！
examples.trans: Look, you made it through both the breakfast rush and the mystery phone call!

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个时期 ('a time').

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

examples.text: 不看纸条，他走进大门时我说什么？
examples.trans: Without my notes, what do I say when he walks in the gate?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn jiàn. Result compound: 看 ('look') + 见 ('perceive') = 'actually see'.

examples.text: 正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
examples.trans: Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gē ge. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个哥哥 ('an older brother').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

条.gloss: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses

meanings.en: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses
meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo. Counts long, narrow, or winding things: streets, rivers, scarves, towels, trousers, and legal clauses (一条街).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē shang. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 整条街上 ('along the street').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng dū. Historic southwestern Chinese city famed for courtyards and tea houses.

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 真的吗？您在成都认识什么人吗？
examples.trans: Really? Do you know someone here in Chengdu?

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì. Means 'correct!' on its own, 'right' as a result complement (拿对), or 'to/toward' before a noun.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huāng. Describes feeling rattled or panicked (别慌 'don't panic').

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
examples.trans: Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!

examples.text: 对。我一慌，按了门铃，把星期五纸条贴在把手上。
examples.trans: Yes. In a panic I rang the bell and taped the Friday note onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: àn. Used for pressing a doorbell, elevator button, or key (按门铃).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén líng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个门铃 ('a doorbell').

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 每个星期五 ('every Friday').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

meanings.en: slip of paper; short written note
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ tiáo. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸条 ('a paper slip / note').

examples.text: 他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
examples.trans: He left a note asking us to keep it until Friday.

examples.text: 对。我一慌，按了门铃，把星期五纸条贴在把手上。
examples.trans: Yes. In a panic I rang the bell and taped the Friday note onto the handle.

related.gloss: a paper slip / note (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiē. Used for taping envelopes, labels, or notices onto a surface.

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

examples.text: 对。我一慌，按了门铃，把星期五纸条贴在把手上。
examples.trans: Yes. In a panic I rang the bell and taped the Friday note onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ shou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个把手 ('a door/suitcase handle').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī sān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这星期三 ('this Wednesday').

examples.text: 等等——星期三晚上你又用真名住进来了？
examples.trans: Wait—and Wednesday night you checked in here under your real name?

examples.text: 每到星期三下午，小美都会试烤新甜点。
examples.trans: Every Wednesday afternoon, Mei test-bakes a new pastry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn míng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个真名 ('a real name').

examples.text: 等等——星期三晚上你又用真名住进来了？
examples.trans: Wait—and Wednesday night you checked in here under your real name?

examples.text: 那是他的小名，很少有人知道他的真名。
examples.trans: That is his childhood nickname; few people know his formal name.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn lái. Friendly invitation 请进来 ('please come in').

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

examples.text: 晚上好！先生，快进来避避雨吧。
examples.trans: Good evening! Sir, come inside quickly out of the rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī qián. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 那之前 ('before that time').

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 先生，上楼之前，我要诚恳跟您道个歉。
examples.trans: Sir, before going upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.

meanings.en: want to; would like to; think; miss
meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng. Before a verb, expresses a polite wish ('would like to'); before a noun/person, 'think of / miss'.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

examples.text: 宋老师早！您想喝咖啡还是红茶？
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! Would you like coffee or black tea?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fù jìn. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 附近一带 ('the nearby area').

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎo. Focuses on searching; add 到 (找到) for actually finding.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ān jìng. Core A1 adjective for quiet courtyards and rooms.

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì fang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个地方 ('a place').

examples.text: 等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？
examples.trans: Wait—what is above the stairs on the third floor?

examples.text: 谢谢你们实话实说，没让我冒雨再找地方。
examples.trans: Thank you both for speaking honestly instead of sending me back into the rain.

meanings.en: as a result; as it turned out; outcome
meanings.note: Pinyin: jié guǒ. Introduces an unexpected outcome or final result.

examples.text: 星期五之前我想在附近找个安静地方，结果不好意思要回箱子！
examples.trans: I needed a quiet place nearby before Friday, and honestly felt too shy to ask for my bag!

examples.text: 以为今天会下雨，结果出了一整天太阳。
examples.trans: We thought it would rain today, and as it turned out the sun shone all day.

meanings.en: excuse me; sorry to bother you; shy
meanings.note: Pinyin: bù hǎo yì si. Polite everyday softener for minor apologies or getting someone's attention.

examples.text: 晚上好。不好意思，把干净地板弄湿了。
examples.trans: Good evening. Sorry for getting your clean floor wet.

examples.text: 打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
examples.trans: Excuse me, Mr Zhihao? Sorry to knock so late.

要回.gloss: to get back, ask back for

examples.text: 他终于从旧货店老板手里要回了祖父的怀表。
examples.trans: He finally got his grandfather's pocket watch back from the antique shop owner.

examples.text: 如果那份老合同还在档案室里，我们一定要把它要回来。
examples.trans: If that old contract is still in the archives, we must make sure to get it back.

examples.text: 他忙得一整天甚至连一口热茶都没顾上喝。
examples.trans: He was so busy all day that he did not even have time for a sip of hot tea.

examples.text: 这架老钢琴音色极佳，甚至连专业的音乐老师都赞不绝口。
examples.trans: This old piano has such a fine tone that even professional music teachers are full of praise.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī èr. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这星期二 ('this Tuesday').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 甚至星期二您还打电话提过白纸包的事！
examples.trans: Even after you called us on Tuesday about the white parcel!

meanings.en: hit; make (a call); give (a score); fetch
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ. Light verb forming dozens of everyday expressions (打电话 'make a phone call').

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn huà. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个电话 ('a phone call').

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

meanings.en: lift up; carry (by a handle); mention
meanings.note: Pinyin: tí. Used for lifting a door handle or carrying a bag by its strap/handle.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

examples.text: 她轻轻解开白纸包，里面是一辆精巧的木头小火车。
examples.trans: She gently untied the white paper parcel; inside was a delicate little wooden train.

examples.text: 柜台上的白纸包里装着刚从药铺买来的薄荷糖。
examples.trans: The white paper parcel on the counter holds peppermint candies just bought from the apothecary.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件事 ('a matter').

examples.text: 您好好休息，有事随时按铃。
examples.trans: Rest well, ma'am; ring the bell anytime if you need anything.

examples.text: 为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
examples.trans: Nervous over a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger by the hour.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bái. Describes white paper, sugar, or tablecloths.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸 ('a sheet of paper').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

related.gloss: a sheet of paper (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāo. As a verb, 'wrap up' (白纸包着); as a noun/classifier, 'bag/packet'.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōng xi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个东西 ('a thing / item').

examples.text: 深呼吸，周经理。还没人写任何东西呢。
examples.trans: Take a deep breath, Manager Zhou. Nobody has written anything yet.

examples.text: 白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。
examples.trans: What is wrapped inside that white paper is for my brother Zhipeng, not mine.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì péng. Given name of Zhihao's younger brother.

examples.text: 白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。
examples.trans: What is wrapped inside that white paper is for my brother Zhipeng, not mine.

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!
